### Explanation
- This chapter describes the detailed pin‑out definitions for common interfaces of our products.
- How to Distinguish Male and Female Connectors
Core Rule: Judge by internal conductive terminals, NOT the outer metal shell!
Male connector (pin‑side): Equipped with protruding metal contact pins inside
Female connector (socket‑side): Equipped with recessed contact jacks inside
**Protruding internal pins → Male connector**
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=78b0f06f0e6115fcde0ef7665eef3a6f)
**Recessed internal jacks → Female connector**
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=5b058849128eb0d2656e4e6e1f51de8e)
